title: Exotic Crunchy Chinese Saskatoon Berries Baozi
description: A sour and crunchy Chinese dish featuring saskatoon berries in a baozi form, double-fry KFC style, and vegan friendly, served in a terracotta dish.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, cornstarch, and salt.
Add the soy milk, rice vinegar, and sesame oil to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a few saskatoon berries in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the berries and press the edges together to seal the baozi.
Dip each baozi into the vegan egg replacement and then coat in the panko breadcrumbs.
Double fry the baozi in hot oil at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 2-3 minutes on each side until golden brown and crispy.
Drain the baozi on paper towels and serve in a terracotta dish.
Drizzle with a little sesame oil and sugar before serving.
